snippet.title: Stigmata Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Stigmata is a PS1 style first person survival horror game influenced by the classics such as Silent Hill and Resident Evil. Featuring methodical combat, inventory management, and an emphasis on atmosphere + psychological horror.

Wishlist here!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4736910/Stigmata/
